title: Trim instruction files that every session loads (Swieta AGENTS.md 36 KB, wilq AGENTS.md 13 KB)
body:
Outcome: Swieta-na-starowce AGENTS.md at most 8 KB (now 35.9 KB, about 9k tokens in every Claude session and Codex worker) and wilq-seo AGENTS.md at most 10 KB; moved detail lives in docs/ and is linked by path.
Evidence (context audit, quoted 2026-11-08 after the files left the checkout; Codex Swieta first turn 36k vs krn 27k): Both audits are from 2026-10-31. Codex: first `token_count` input tokens from rollouts, 10-14 sessions per project, bytes/4. Swieta 36.0k median (AGENTS.md 35.9 KB, about 9.0k tokens), wilq-seo 29.7k (AGENTS.md 13.4 KB, chain 15.1 KB). Claude Code: first assistant message input+cache tokens. Swieta 55.0k median (n=4, instructions 39.7 KB on first turn, 21.2 KB later), wilq-seo 66.8k (n=1, instructions 15.0 KB). Targets: Swieta ≤8 KB, wilq about 6 KB.
Proof: first-turn tokens measured before and after with the context-audit baseline scripts (/mnt/storage/tmp/krn/claude/context-audit/).
Scope: those two repositories, through their own workflow; no rule is dropped, only moved.
